subject: Tiny queue glitch
text:
Hey,

I wanted to mention a tiny glitch on the ticket queue. The auto-close rule marked three chats as finished too early. I’m fixing the script now, but it might keep popping up until the patch lands.

Anyway, my laundry mountain is still unfinished, so I can pretend the chaos is just work training. Hope you’re surviving too. Also, please don’t remind me about the recycling bin again today, friend.
